notes.title: Progress report on English translation work
notes.notes:
The English translation is currently undergoing some difficulties.
We have decided to postpone the release of the English translation until next year.


We apologize to those who have been looking forward to this project
We are very sorry for this.

notes.title: 20% OFF sale
notes.notes:
Currently 20% off! !
The English translation work is also underway towards the end of the year.

notes.title: Fixed a bug that prevented startup.
notes.notes: We have rebuilt the game because we have confirmed a bug that causes the game to stop at startup with a message "セーブデータの移動を検知しました　『Detection of movement of saved data』". We apologize for the inconvenience. If you are experiencing similar messages, please uninstall the software and reinstall it.

notes.title: Correction of typographical errors in the Japanese version
notes.notes:
Typographical errors and omissions have been corrected in the Japanese version.
MAC support will be added soon.
Work on the English version is progressing smoothly.

notes.title: English translation work started! and about MAC support
notes.notes:
MAC support will be available by the end of the year.
And we are currently working with a translator.
And we plan to update the game so that it can be played in English by the end of next year.

We will keep you updated on the details as the work progresses.
